title: Preserve a bounded admission contract
prompt: Complete Admission. submit accepts values from 0 through 100 while count is below its capacity. Return false for invalid values or a full queue without changing count. The model is single-threaded. size() reports accepted submissions.
signature: class Admission: bool submit(int value); std::size_t size() const

tests.label: Valid submission
tests.hint: Increase the count only after acceptance.

tests.label: Capacity is enforced
tests.hint: Full means count is already at the limit.

hints: A failed call must leave count_ unchanged.
explanation: Admission is a small failure boundary: a caller sees either acceptance with a state change, or rejection with the old state preserved. Concurrent callers would need additional synchronization.
